### tasks

## Interfaces

### Task

```ts
interface Task {
    title: string;
    /** `pending` when omitted. */
    status?: TaskStatus;
    /** A line under the title — the step's current detail, shown only on a terminal. */
    detail?: string;
}
```

### TasksOptions

```ts
interface TasksOptions {

}
```
